Minotaur Laura is here to wreak havoc on the ancient world. Her quest to challenge a god will see her dominate, crush, capture, fuck and devour man and beast alike. With a burning desire for vengeance in her heart she will stop at nothing to bring down anyone in her path.
Go on expeditions, fighting humans and monsters in turn-based battles. Subdued enemies can be captured and kept as pets. Grow Laura’s powers by performing rituals and offering sacrifices.
